📺 The Greatest (2026)

The Greatest tells the extraordinary story of Muhammad Ali, one of the most influential athletes in history. The biographical drama explores his journey from a talented young boxer named Cassius Clay to a global sporting icon whose confidence, charisma, and determination changed boxing forever. Beyond his legendary fights, the series examines his personal relationships, religious beliefs, political convictions, and the challenges he faced outside the ring. As Ali rises to international fame, he must navigate the pressures of success while remaining committed to his principles. Through powerful storytelling, The Greatest celebrates his courage, resilience, cultural impact, and lasting legacy as a champion who inspired generations around the world.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Drama • Sports

🎥 Creator: Ben Watkins

📺 Where to Watch: Prime Video (planned release).
